name: avenir-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for YNAB: budgets, spending and transaction classification, built for agents.
long_description:
Ask Claude about the plan you keep in YNAB: what is left in a category, where the money went last month, whether you will run short before payday. avenir-mcp answers from your own YNAB data, and nothing else.

It is **read-only when you install it**. Tick *Allow changes to your plans* and the agent can also classify transactions, move money between categories, reconcile an account and create one: every change is shown to you before it happens, you confirm it, and it can be undone.

You need a YNAB account and a personal access token, which YNAB gives you under *Account settings > Developer settings*. avenir-mcp is not made by YNAB, and it never touches a bank account: it changes a plan in YNAB, never real money.

ynab_api_key.title: YNAB personal access token
ynab_api_key.description: In YNAB, open Account settings > Developer settings > New Token. The token can read and change every plan of your account: YNAB offers no read-only one. Claude Desktop keeps it out of sight here, and avenir-mcp never logs it and never returns it in an answer.

allow_changes.title: Allow changes to your plans
allow_changes.description: Leave this off and avenir-mcp answers questions and changes nothing. Turn it on and the agent can also classify transactions, budget, reconcile and create: it shows you each change, waits for your yes, and can undo it afterwards.
